clue.text: Amount charged must include a court for training

indicators.note: the price has to take the following pieces inside it

parts.note: the amount charged for something is its price

explanation.surface: A fee that covers hire of a court for someone's sports training sessions.
explanation.definitionFit: Training and repeated rehearsal of a skill are synonyms, as in piano or football drills.

clue.text: Squashes questions about 2 for example

indicators.note: the questioning word goes around the relatives word

parts.note: to pump someone is to question them persistently
the answer to clue 2 (aunts) is an example of one's relatives, kin

explanation.surface: Someone interrogating relatives about something, with a cross-reference to another clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Squashes' looks like a verb but is the plural noun: vegetables of the gourd family.
explanation.definitionFit: Squashes are gourd vegetables, and the orange Halloween kind is a familiar example.

clue.text: Pleasure trips must start late for these relations

indicators.note: the word begins later than usual, so its opening letter is dropped

parts.note: jaunts are short trips taken for pleasure

explanation.surface: Relatives who always set off late on their outings.
explanation.definitionFit: Sisters of one's parents are relations, a family relationship.

clue.text: Weapon that's free, wrapped in canvas

indicators.note: the freeing word sits wrapped inside the canvas word

parts.note: a tent is a canvas shelter, so canvas stands for it
to rid is to free, as in rid of pests

explanation.surface: A weapon given away for nothing, wrapped up in canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-pronged spear, as carried by Neptune, is a weapon.

clue.text: Stuff credit — a source of misery!

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it starts, its opening letter

explanation.surface: A grumble that buying things on credit only leads to misery.
explanation.definitionFit: To stuff is to pack or force too much in, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Some oddly stuffing face must be miserable

indicators.note: the chosen letters are pushed inside the face word

parts.note: dial is slang for a person's face

indicators.note: only the letters in odd positions of the word are kept

explanation.surface: Someone stuffing their face oddly must be unhappy.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismal and miserable are synonyms for gloomy or wretched.

clue.text: Meanwhile at home, call about investments, initially

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

indicators.note: the naming word goes around the chosen letter

parts.note: to term something is to call or name it

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Staying at home and phoning about one's investments in the meantime.
explanation.definitionFit: Interim as an adverb or noun means in the meantime, a synonym.

clue.text: Hormone present in rampant Latino men?

indicators.note: running wild and unrestrained, so the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: A wry question whether some hormone drives wild Latin men.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the hormone produced by the pineal gland that regulates sleep.

clue.text: Provides drama ignoring quiet lad

indicators.note: the quiet letter is left out of the drama word

parts.note: a play is a drama
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
a son is a lad

explanation.surface: A theatre staging drama while ignoring a quiet boy.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay on a meal or transport is to provide it, a phrasal verb synonym.

clue.text: Beggar working in tandem with head of charity

indicators.note: the letters are put to work in a fresh arrangement
the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A beggar teaming up with the boss of a charity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' is the anagram signal, rearranging IN TANDEM together with C from 'head of charity'.
explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant lives by begging, especially a friar of a begging order.

clue.text: Commanding Officer captured by Attila ordered such a jacket

indicators.note: the officer sits inside the rearranged name
the letters of the name are put into a different order

parts.note: CO is the military abbreviation for Commanding Officer

explanation.surface: An officer taken prisoner by Attila the Hun, who orders a jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailcoat is a formal jacket with long tails at the back.

clue.text: Match score

definitions.meaning: to match or correspond, as figures that agree
a running count or total of points

explanation.definitionFit: Accounts that agree are said to correspond, and a running count of points is also this word.

clue.text: Destiny of king is satisfied

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
to meet a need is to satisfy it, so satisfied gives met

explanation.surface: Whether a monarch's fate is fulfilled.
explanation.definitionFit: Kismet is fate or destiny, from Turkish via Arabic.

clue.text: Look to include unusually bitter words to score

indicators.note: the exclamation takes the rearranged letters inside it

parts.note: lo is an old exclamation meaning look

indicators.note: the letters are arranged in an unusual way

explanation.surface: Advice to watch for bitter words in a musical score.
explanation.definitionFit: The text of an opera is set to the score, so it is the words for the music.

clue.text: Posture adopted by coach?

definitions.meaning: the way one holds and bears one's body
a horse-drawn coach or a railway coach

explanation.definitionFit: Deportment or bearing of the body, and a passenger vehicle on rails or drawn by horses, share this word.

clue.text: Job in the dark for an astronomer?

definitions.text: Job in the dark for an astronomer?

parts.words: Job in the dark for an astronomer?
parts.note: a watcher at night guarding a building, whimsically recast as a stargazer's job

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads the word as someone who watches the night sky, but the real job is security guard.
explanation.definitionFit: A guard who patrols premises overnight, or in cricket a lower-order batsman sent in late in the day.

clue.text: Pet subject of experimentation

definitions.meaning: a cavy, a small rodent kept as a pet
a person or creature used in a trial or test

explanation.definitionFit: The cavy is a common rodent pet, and the same name is used for anyone tested on.

clue.text: Offended, being able to see across lake

indicators.note: the sighted word stretches across the lake letter

parts.note: sighted means able to see
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: Someone upset at being able to see across a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: To be slighted is to be snubbed or insulted, so offended.

clue.text: Tarantino line rewritten for test, perhaps

indicators.note: the words are written again with letters reordered

explanation.surface: A line of film director Quentin Tarantino's dialogue being rewritten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'test' is a test match: in cricket and rugby, a full match between national sides.
explanation.definitionFit: A test match is an example of a fixture between national teams.

clue.text: One sheltering in canopy is more irritable

indicators.note: the numeral takes shelter inside the canopy word

parts.note: a tester is a canopy over a four-poster bed
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone sheltering under a canopy who gets grumpier.
explanation.definitionFit: Testy means irritable, so this comparative is more irritable.

clue.text: Seize contents of limo and crush

indicators.note: the contents of a word are its inner letters without the ends

parts.note: to pound is to crush

explanation.surface: Taking things from inside a limousine and crushing it.
explanation.definitionFit: To impound is to seize legally, like a car taken by police.

clue.text: Absurd score — around 100 — for such a game

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the numeral
an absurd ordering of the letters signals a jumble

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for 100

explanation.surface: A ridiculous scoreline of about a hundred in some game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Absurd' turns SCORE into SOCER, and 'around' puts C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Association football is a game, and this is its common name.

clue.text: Understands broadcast by mistress losing head abroad

indicators.note: the spoken word goes beside the shortened mistress word
the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: a mistress is a lover

indicators.note: broadcast means spoken out, so the word is replaced by one sounding the same

parts.note: to see a point is to understand it

explanation.surface: Someone understanding a message broadcast by their mistress after she loses her head.
explanation.walkthrough: The parts are placed in answer order: OVER from 'mistress losing head' first, then the sound of 'sees'.
explanation.definitionFit: Overseas and abroad are synonyms, meaning in foreign countries.

clue.text: Water jump?

definitions.meaning: a natural source of water rising from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: A natural outflow of water from the ground and a sudden leap share this word.

clue.text: Useless writer held up by Italian

indicators.note: the reversed pen is held inside the Italian abbreviation
in a down clue the word reads upward, so backwards

parts.note: a pen is a writing tool

explanation.surface: An unhelpful author detained by an Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' works as a reversal because this is a down entry, read from the bottom; 'held ... by' is split around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Inept means lacking skill, so useless.

clue.text: Prices of admission will include seating

indicators.note: the phrase contains the letters within its run

explanation.surface: Ticket prices that cover a seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A couch is a piece of seating furniture.

clue.text: Island republic a prince tours

indicators.note: the island is found by touring through these words, its letters running across them

explanation.surface: A prince touring an island republic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'republic' and 'prince' tempt one to build abbreviations; the island simply sits inside the words as written.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Italian island in the Bay of Naples, a resort famous for its Blue Grotto.

clue.text: English tombstone with line replacing one name as compensation

indicators.note: the line letter takes the place of the name letter

parts.note: a monument can be a tombstone
N is the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: An English gravestone recut with a different name to make amends.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the first N of MONUMENT is swapped for L.
explanation.definitionFit: An emolument is a salary or fee, so payment or compensation for work.

clue.text: Look at soldiers and pull back

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: the word is read back to front

parts.note: to drag is to pull

explanation.surface: Watching soldiers before they retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: To regard something is to look at it attentively, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Old-fashioned chap having precedence is given authority

indicators.note: this piece comes first, before the old-fashioned word

parts.note: a chap is a man
dated means old-fashioned

explanation.surface: A fusty man with seniority who is given power.
explanation.definitionFit: Being mandated means being formally authorised to act.
